scripts.train:sync:raw: npx --yes supabase gen types typescript --project-id "$SUPABASE_PROJECT_REF" > src/types.ts && node --loader ts-node/esm scripts/sync-training.ts
scripts.train:validate: if [ -n "$SUPABASE_PROJECT_REF" ]; then npx --yes supabase gen types typescript --project-id "$SUPABASE_PROJECT_REF" > src/types.ts; else echo "SUPABASE_PROJECT_REF not set; skipping live type generation"; fi && npm run build
scripts.kb:refresh: npm run kb:update:railway && npm run docs:sync
scripts.train:all: npm run train:sync && npm run docs:sync
